title: VAT matrix cleanup or alternative route decision
purpose: Stop repeating direct Page 472 list-edit routes after D8 and decide whether the partial INLAND/VAT19 row should be cleaned/recreated or whether another standard Business Central route exists.

decisionOptions.description: Delete only the partial INLAND/VAT19 row if Business Central shows a row-scoped confirmation and then recreate it through a safer route.
Find a standard BC route such as Kopieren/Copy or assisted setup that can produce a complete VAT Posting Setup row without blind cell typing.
Park VAT matrix completion and document that posting groups, master data and document cases remain blocked until VAT is solved.

acceptanceCriteria: No BC or Playwright execution in this decision case unless a follow-up execute case is created.
Explicitly rejects repeating D3/D5/D8 direct cell/list-edit routes.
If cleanup is selected, the next execute case must require row-scoped delete confirmation before deleting anything.
If alternative UI route is selected, it must identify the exact page/action and stop before Preview Posting or Posting.
Master data, drafts, Preview Posting and Posting stay locked.
